podcast.body: Released in 1988, this industrial music track extensively features the Yamaha DX7 synthesizer. With the possible exception of the drum track, the song is almost entirely composed using the DX7, showcasing the instrument's maximum advantage and its role in shaping the sound of the 1980s. "With the exception of the drum track, and frankly, I'm not even sure that's not included, this song by Front242 is pretty much entirely DX7."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Music Questions People Almost Never Ask

podcast.body: This song is from Front 242's 1988 album "Front by Front" and is presented as a key track from their period of gaining significant recognition. "It's called Headhunter."
